wholeOriginalHEGoal.title: Familienplanung und Verhütung
wholeOriginalHEGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Methoden der Empfängnisregelung beurteilen und verantwortliche Elternschaft reflektieren.
wholeOriginalHEGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can assess methods of contraception and reflect on responsible parenthood.

sourceScope: WholeHE9.3 source separates contraceptive family planning/parenthood and social/emotional perspectives. Optional hormone feedback stays optional. Adjacent pregnancy/birth/abortion or other endocrine topics are not silently added to the split children.
conditionalSTIScope: The original reviewed P already separates pregnancy prevention and STI protection. In the bounded HE teaching context, originalHE9.2 HIV prevention and supplied institutional method information support this criterion. No whole-country obligation is inferred from copied raw applicability.
